correctness.rationale: The proof first exactly classifies random circle intersections with an axial surface zone; independent uniform axial normal and signed offset produce a rigorously normalized cosine-density integral. Standalone code independently corroborates with quadrature and raw-plane simulations.

value.rationale: The simplest topological statistic of affine plane sections of a spherical latitude band receives a complete exact 0/1/2 distribution. The one-component law has a rigid and unexpected equality with the surface-area fraction exactly for centered bands, plus strict positional shape-ordering and a sharp half-area threshold with square-root onset for the minimum disconnected-section probability. These are natural all-parameter classifications rather than isolated tables, radius-law substitutions, or routine checks.
